description: Central Kyiv (Maidan Nezalezhnosti / Pechersk) drive network + facilities
synthetic_note: Road network and the large majority of facilities are real OSM data. A small number of shelter points may be synthesized (see is_synthetic=true on individual facility features) only when OSM's shelter coverage in this bbox is sparse; live outage/power status shown by the app is ALWAYS simulated, never real-time, regardless of whether the underlying facility is real or synthetic.
